title: Layla SDK Diagnostics
tagline: Verify every Layla SDK surface in one run.
description: Run a complete diagnostics suite against the Layla SDK and native host bridge. Check chat, characters, memories, personas, sentiment, files, database access, contextual events, text-to-speech, image and music generation, microphone input, background audio, and per-lane concurrency. Safe checks run by default, while heavier generation and audio checks remain opt-in.
